_comment: An OpenAI-compatible chat completion carrying one picture and one question.
Two things were wrong with the copy this replaces, and both are fixed here:
* it named the model 'qwen3.8-flash-next'. Nothing on this box serves that
id -- GET /health on the running Strata reports 'qwen3.8-flash-next-iq2_xs'
and so does GET /v1/models through the gateway -- so the sample could not
have worked even against an engine that had the vision encoder loaded.
* it pointed at evidence/resume_sample.png, which is not in the repository
The picture is now drawn, not shipped: run
and red_square.png appears beside this file. Nothing is downloaded and no
real document is involved -- a fixture that has to be a real CV is a fixture
The placeholder below is filled in by examples/vision/request_contract.py,
which substitutes the drawn fixture and then runs this request through
Strata's own parser to check the shape is the shape a server accepts.

messages.content: You are a strict resume screener. Answer with exactly one word: YES or NO. No punctuation, no explanation.

content.text: Is the large central shape red? Answer with exactly one word: YES or NO.

_what_this_sample_does_not_do: It is not a test of answer quality. A reply of YES from a running engine
would say the picture reached the model, not that the model read it -- see
the 'a 200 is not accuracy' control in
On this host a picture request is rejected before it gets that far: Strata
is running without --vision and GET /health reports "images": false.
Do not point this at the production port to find out.
